'''Black Leader''' was a [[Callsign/Legends|call sign]] used by various [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] unit commanders:
*[[Juno Eclipse/Legends|Juno Eclipse]] was called "Black Leader" when place in command of [[Black Eight Squadron]].
*[[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]] is attributed with the moniker "Black Leader" when commanding [[Black Squadron (Galactic Empire)/Legends|Black Squadron]].
*[[Hodo]] was called "Black Leader" or "Black One" while leading [[Black Flight]].
